title: Farmer Brown: Win a Private Dining Experience for Six
prize: Three winners each receive a private-chef dinner for themselves and five guests, all aged 18+. Venue/date are agreed after the draw; the promoter may substitute a dinner-at-home kit where a dinner cannot be hosted locally.
entrySummary: Entrants must be in South Africa, aged 18+, with a South African ID, passport or documentary proof of South African residency under the written rules. Promoter-linked people and their immediate family are excluded. The live entry form specifically asks for a South African ID number. Buy two products from the participating Nourish/Naked list at SPAR, Checkers or Pick n Pay. Use the campaign QR code or the official campaign site linked below. Provide the required name/contact/location details, choose the retailer, accept the competition terms, and upload a full, clear receipt. Marketing opt-in is presented separately. Keep your original till slip. Multiple entries need separate qualifying purchases; a participant may win once. Winner plus five guests must all be 18+. Travel, accommodation, extra food/drink and tips are excluded. Dinner must take place within three months of notification; confirm availability within the promoter’s ten-working-day window. Beverage pairing may include alcohol. Dinner photography/publicity provisions apply. Terms broadly permit marketing processing, despite the form offering a yes/no opt-in choice. Winner verification includes identification/residency evidence and the original receipt. Participating products/prize allocation from the official terms: Farmer Brown Frozen Fillet Sourdough — 360g — 6001407106849 — F/BROWN FILLET FRZ 360G S/DOUG; Farmer Brown Frozen Fillet Wholegrain — 360g — 6001407106856 — F/BROWN FILLET FRZ 360G W/GRN; Farmer Brown Frozen Fillet Lightly Dusted — 360g — 6001407106863 — F/BROWN FILLET FRZ 360G L/BRD; Farmer Brown Frozen Strips Sourdough — 400g — 6001407107839 — F/BROWN STRIPS 400GR SOURDOUGH; Farmer Brown Frozen Strips Wholegrain — 400g — 6001407107846 — F/BROWN STRIPS 400GR WHLEGRAIN; Farmer Brown Frozen Strips Lightly Dusted — 400g — 6001407107853 — F/BROWN STRIPS 400GR LIBREADED; Farmer Brown Naked Frozen Breast — 1kg — 6001407108119 — F/BROWN NAKED FRZ 1KG BRST FIL; Farmer Brown Naked Frozen Thighs — 1kg — 6001407108089 — F/BROWN NAKED FRZ 1KG THIGHS; Farmer Brown Naked Frozen Drumsticks — 1kg — 6001407108102 — F/BROWN NAKED FRZ IKG DRUMS.
